# Anker Tattoo & Piercing Studio Freiburg

> Anker Studio is a premier custom tattoo, professional body piercing, and PMU (permanent make-up) studio located in Freiburg im Breisgau, Germany.

## Business Profile & Entities
- **Legal Name**: Anker Tattoo & Piercing Studio
- **Industry**: Health & Beauty / Body Modification
- **Location**: Freiburg im Breisgau, Baden-Württemberg, Germany
- **Primary Domain**: https://anker-freiburg.de
- **Locales Supported**: de (Deutsch), en (English), fr (Français)

## Core Services & Specialties
- **Custom Tattoos**: Custom artwork, Wannados (flash designs), Cover-Ups, Black & Grey, Fine Line, Traditional, and Color work.
- **Professional Body Piercing**: Hygienic piercing procedures, initial jewelry insertion (ASTM F136 Implant-Grade Titanium, Solid Gold), jewelry downsizing, stretchings, and consultations.
- **PMU (Permanent Make-Up)**: Powder Brows, Lip Blush / Lip Pigmentation, Microblading.
- **Jewelry Sales**: High-end anodized titanium, solid gold piercing jewelry, and custom fittings.

## Critical Business Policies
- **Jugendschutz (Youth Protection) & U18 Rules**:
  - Tattoos: Strictly 18+ only.
  - Piercings under 18: Requires an official physical Einverständniserklärung (consent form) signed by an Erziehungsberechtigte (legal guardian).
  - Minor and legal guardian must present an original, official Personalausweis (identity card) or Reisepass (passport) in person.
- **Hygiene Standards**: Complies strictly with the local Infektionshygieneverordnung (infection hygiene ordinance). Uses single-use sterile equipment and autoclaves.

## Service Workflow
- **Consultations & Appointments**: Booked via the website contact form at https://anker-freiburg.de/kontakt or direct studio visits.
- **Walk-Ins**: Accepted daily based on capacity (primarily for body piercings and jewelry changeouts).
